newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Dolenjska to list 5,000 more shares.
newsitem.headline: Dolenjska to list 5,000 more shares.

text.p: Slovenian bank Dolenjska will extend its listing on the Ljubljana bourse by launching another 5,000 shares, the bourse said on Monday.
Dolenjska bank will increase the number of shares to 190,802 ordinary shares from the current 185,802 with a nominal value of 8,000 tolars ($50.3) each.
The bourse said the exact date of the expanded quotation has not yet been determined.
On June 27, the Bank of Slovenia gave the green light to Daiwa Europe to buy 3.51 percent of Dolenjska banka.
At 1025 GMT Dolenjska bank's ordinary shares were 1.38 percent or 200 tolars up at 14,700 tolars on volume of 56 shares. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
